title: Jev
description: Optional typed judgement over Babel records: per-record voters, pair relations and bounded duplicate-cluster proposals. Free plans precede explicit paid judgement. It holds no store, panel or write authority. Suggestions return for separate operator delivery; cached current readings may prioritize the shared review draw through an authenticated ephemeral handoff. Missing or disabled readings retain baseline selection; funding is unknown. Jev cannot rule, apply links, change feed rank, withhold work or launch a session.

atyrode.babel.reason: every candidate, immutable revision and provenance is read through Babel's doors; suggestions return to the caller and Jev writes nothing
